text.html: Superfoods Partners is our sourcing operation in Hong Kong. If you already work with Pure Matcha Partners, you are already tapping into the same sourcing, screening and documentation. For new B2B buyers, Superfoods Partners supplies bulk matcha, tea and superfoods with full traceability — one pair of hands from farm to freight.
